options.name: running_config
options.description: This option is used only with state I(parsed). The value of this option should be the output received from the NX-OS device by executing the commands B(show vlans | json-pretty) and B(show running-config | section ^vlan) in order and delimited by a line. The state I(parsed) reads the configuration from C(running_config) option and transforms it into Ansible structured data as per the resource module's argspec and the value is then returned in the I(parsed) key within the result.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the configuration after module completion. The state I(overridden) would override the configuration of all the VLANs on the device (including VLAN 1) with the provided configuration in the task. Use caution with this state.
